zh: “罗四小姐，你驳得有道理，不过你如果晓得用在哪里，你就不会驳了。宫殿有各式各样的宫殿，何止三宫六院？看地方，看用场，陈设大不相同，通通是龙凤的花佯，千篇一律，看都看厌了。你说，是不是呢？““话倒也不错。那么，这堂木器是用在哪里的呢？”“是要用在圆明园的……”“李老板，你真当我乡下人了！ 哪个不晓得，” 洋鬼子把圆明园烧掉了。““烧掉了可以重造啊。当然，真的重造了，这堂木器也不会在我这里了。”
en: “Your objection is reasonable, Miss Luo. But if you knew where the furniture was intended to go, you would not object. There are all sorts of palaces, far more than the familiar Three Palaces and Six Courts. The furnishings differ greatly according to the place and its purpose. If everything had the same dragons and phoenixes, people would grow tired of looking at them. Wouldn't you agree?” “There is something in that. Where was this set to be used, then?” “At the Yuanmingyuan…” “Mr Li, you really do take me for a country bumpkin! Who doesn't know that the foreign devils burned the Yuanmingyuan down?” “What has been burned can be rebuilt. Of course, if it really had been rebuilt, this furniture would not be here.”

zh: 据李老板说，有班内务府的人，与宫中管事的太监，因为洪杨起义已经失败，捻军亦部打败了，不足为患，因而怂恿慈禧太后说：“再过三，四年，皇帝成年，‘大婚’、‘亲政’两桩大典一过，两宫太后应该有个颐养天年的地方，大可以将颐和园恢复起来。大后‘以天下养’，修个花园，不为过分。”慈禧太后心动了，十二、三岁的小皇帝更为起劲，风声一传，有个内务府出身、在广东干了好几任肥缺的知府，得风气之先，特制酸枝嵌螺甸的木器进贡，而在由海道北运途中，事情起了变化。原来这件事，在私底下已经谈了好几个月，当政的恭亲王大不以为然，不过不便说破，只是在两宫太后每天例行召见时，不断表示，大乱初平，百废等举，财政困难，意思是希望慈禧太后自动打消这个念头。哪知恭王正在下水磨功夫时，忽然听说有定样一个知府，居然进贡木器，准备在颐和园使用，不由得大为光火，授意一个满洲的御史，肿列这个知府贪污有据的劣迹，狠狠参了一本，恭王面请“革职查办”，慈禧太后不便庇护，准如所请，那知府就此下狱。贡品自然也就不必北运了，押运的是那知府的胞弟，将木器卸在上海变卖，是这样归于昌发的。
en: According to Mr Li, some men from the Imperial Household Department and the eunuchs in charge of palace affairs had argued that, since the uprising of Hong and Yang had been defeated and the Nian armies crushed, there was no longer any cause for concern. They had therefore urged Empress Dowager Cixi: “In another three or four years, the emperor will come of age. Once the two great ceremonies of his marriage and assumption of personal rule are over, the two empress dowagers ought to have somewhere to spend their later years in comfort. The Yiheyuan could perfectly well be restored. Her Majesty is supported by the whole empire. Building a garden is hardly excessive.” Cixi was tempted, and the young emperor, then twelve or thirteen, was even more enthusiastic. When word spread, a prefect who had come from the Imperial Household Department and served several lucrative terms in Guangdong was quick to seize the opportunity. He commissioned a special set of suanzhi furniture with mother-of-pearl inlay as tribute. While it was being shipped north by sea, however, circumstances changed. The scheme had been discussed privately for several months. Prince Gong, who was directing the government, strongly disapproved but could not say so openly. At the two empress dowagers' regular daily audiences, he therefore kept stressing that the great disorders had only just been suppressed, countless neglected affairs needed attention, and the treasury was in difficulty. He hoped Cixi would abandon the idea herself. While he was pursuing this patient campaign, news arrived of a prefect sending furniture as tribute for use at the Yiheyuan. Furious, he instructed a Manchu censor to impeach the man with a detailed account of proven corruption. Prince Gong personally asked for his dismissal and investigation. Cixi could hardly protect him and granted the request. The prefect was imprisoned. Naturally, there was no longer any reason to ship the tribute north. His younger brother, who was escorting it, unloaded it in Shanghai and sold it. That was how it had come to Changfa.

zh: “木器一共三堂，一堂客厅，一堂书房，都卖掉了。现在剩下这一堂，前天有个江西来的候补道来看过，东西是欢喜得不得了，银子带得不够，叫我替他留十天，他没有下定洋，我就不管他了。罗四小姐，你要中意，我特别克己。”李老板又说：“我再说句老实话，这堂木器，也没有啥人用得起，你们想，房间里用这样子讲究的木器，大厅、花厅、书房应该用啥？这就是我这堂木器，不容易脱手的道理。罗四姐心想，照他的话看，这堂木器似乎也只有胡雪岩家用得起。不想居然也还有那么一个阔气的江西候补道，转念又想，胡雪岩也是江西候补道，莫非是他叫人来看过？于是她问：“那个江西候补道姓啥？看来他倒也是用得起的。”“姓朱。”李老板又说：“朱道台想买这堂木器也不是自己用，是打算孝敬一位总督的老太太的。”罗四姐心中一动，随即问说：“你这堂木器啥价钱？”“照本卖，一千五百两银。其实照本卖，已经把利息亏在里头了。好在另外两堂，我已经赚着了，这一堂亏点本也无所谓。”
en: “There were three sets in all: one for a reception hall, one for a study, and this one. The first two have been sold. An expectant circuit intendant from Jiangxi came to see this set the day before yesterday. He loved it, but hadn't brought enough money and asked me to keep it for ten days. Since he paid no deposit, I need not consider him. If you like it, Miss Luo, I shall give you an especially modest price. To tell you the truth, very few people can afford to use furniture like this. If a bedroom is furnished so splendidly, what must the main hall, garden drawing room and study contain? That is why this set is so difficult to sell.” Luo thought that, by his account, perhaps only Hu's household could use it. She had not imagined that an expectant circuit intendant from Jiangxi might be equally wealthy. Then it occurred to her that Hu himself held that designation. Could he have sent someone to look at it? “What is this gentleman's surname? He must be able to afford it.” “Zhu. But Circuit Intendant Zhu was not buying it for himself. He meant to present it to a governor-general's mother.” An idea stirred in Luo's mind. “What is your price?” “Fifteen hundred taels, at cost. In fact, even selling at cost means losing the interest on the money tied up in it. Still, I have made my profit on the other two sets. I don't mind losing a little on this one.”

zh: “李老板，我还你一个整数。”“罗四小姐，”李老板苦笑着说：“三分天下去其一，你杀价也杀得太凶了。”“本来漫天要价，就地还钱，‘对折拦腰掼’的生意还多的是。”“罗四小姐，听你口音是杭州人？”“不错。你问它作啥？”“你们杭州人杀价厉害，‘对折拦腰掼’四分天下去其三，世界上哪里有这种生意。罗四小姐，你总要高升、高升吧？”高升又高升，讲定一千二百两银子。罗四姐是带了银票来的，取了一张四百两的，捏在手中，却有一番话交代。“李老板，你要照我的话，我们这笔交易才会成功，明天我带个人来看，问你啥价钱，你说八百两银子。”“这为啥？”“你不要管。”罗四姐说：“你要一千二百两，今天我付你四百，明天再付你八百，一文不少。”罗四姐又说：“你要在收条上写明白，一定照我的话，不照我的话，交易不成，加倍退定洋。”“是，是！我照办。”于是李老板收下定洋，打了收条。等罗四姐走后不久，又来了一个老主顾。
en: “I will offer you a round thousand, Mr Li.” He smiled wryly. “Miss Luo, you are taking away a third of the price. That is ruthless bargaining.” “The seller asks for the sky; the buyer offers the ground. Plenty of bargains are made by halving the price and then halving it again.” “From your accent, are you from Hangzhou?” “Yes. Why do you ask?” “You Hangzhou people bargain hard. Halving it twice means taking away three quarters. Where in the world can anyone do business like that? You must raise your offer a little, Miss Luo.” After several increases, they settled on twelve hundred taels. Luo had brought banknotes. Taking out one for four hundred taels and holding it in her hand, she laid down a condition. “This sale can go through only if you do as I say. Tomorrow I shall bring someone to look. If you are asked the price, say eight hundred taels.” “Why?” “Never mind that. You want twelve hundred. I shall pay you four hundred today and another eight hundred tomorrow, not a cash less. But you must state clearly on the receipt that you will follow my instructions. If you don't, the sale is cancelled and you must return double the deposit.” “Certainly. I shall do as you say.” Mr Li accepted the deposit and wrote the receipt. Shortly after Luo left, another regular customer arrived.

zh: “唷，唷！古太太，我财神又临门了。今天想看点啥？”“看了再说。”李老板领着她一处处处看，看到那堂螺甸酸枝木器，站住脚问：“这堂木器啥价钱？”“对不起，古太太，刚刚卖掉了……”七姑奶奶大失所望，却未死心，“卖给哪个？”她说，“哪有这么巧的事？”见此光景，李老板心里在转念头，他原来的话，还有一句：“就是罗四小姐买的。”哪知话未说完，让“古太太”截断了，看她的样子，有势在必得之意，如果说破“罗四小姐”，她一定会跟人家去商量情让，那一来事情就尴尬了。“罗四小姐”人很厉害，少惹她为妙。打定了这个主意，便不答腔，七姑奶却是越看越中意，就越不肯死心，“你卖给人家多少钱？”她问。“既然卖掉了，古太太也就不必问了。”“咦，姨！”七姑奶奶放下脸来，“当场开销，”她说：“问问怕啥，李老板你是生意做得大，架子也大呢？还是上了年纪，越老越糊涂？做生意哪有你这个做法的，问都问不得一句！”“古太太你不要骂我。”李老板灵机一动，顿时将苦笑收起，平静地问道：“我先请教古太太两句话，可以不可以？”
en: “Mrs Gu! Here is my God of Wealth again. What would you like to see today?” “Let me look around first.” Mr Li showed her from one area to another. When they reached the suanzhi set with mother-of-pearl inlay, she stopped. “How much is this?” “I am sorry, Mrs Gu. It has just been sold…” Deeply disappointed but unwilling to give up, the Seventh Lady asked, “To whom? What an unlucky coincidence!” Mr Li considered the situation. He had intended to add, “Miss Luo has just bought it,” but Mrs Gu had cut him short. She looked determined to have it. If he named Luo, she would certainly ask her to yield it, and that would make things awkward. Miss Luo was formidable; the less he provoked her, the better. Having reached this conclusion, he said nothing. But the more the Seventh Lady looked, the more she liked the furniture and the less willing she was to let it go. “What price did you sell it for?” “Since it has been sold, there is no need to ask, Mrs Gu.” Her face hardened, and she began to give him a dressing-down on the spot. “What is wrong with asking? Has your business grown so large that you have become too grand for us, Mr Li? Or are you growing more muddle-headed with age? Who ever heard of doing business like this, when a customer may not even ask a question?” “Please don't scold me.” An inspiration came to him. His rueful smile vanished, and he asked calmly, “May I first ask you a couple of questions?”

zh: “可以啊！有什么不可以？”“古太太想买这堂木器，是自己用，还是送人？”“送人。”“送哪个？”“你不要管。”“古太太，你告诉我了，或许有个商量。”“好。”七姑奶奶说：“喏，就是上回我同她来过的那位罗四小姐。”这下，李老板会意了，“罗四小姐”所说要带个人来看，此人就在眼前。于是他笑着道：“古太太，你说巧来真是巧！刚刚那个买主，就是罗四小姐。”七姑奶奶大感意外，心想：“她来过了？”她急急问说：“买了你这堂木器？多少钱？”“八百两。”七姑奶奶点点头，“这个价钱也还公道。”她又问：“付了多少定洋？”“没有付。”“没有付？”七姑奶奶气又上来了：“没有付，你为啥不卖给我？”“做生意一句话嘛！罗四小姐是你古太太的来头，我当然要相信她。”七姑奶奶觉得他这两句话很中听，不由得就说了实话，“李老板，我老实跟你说了吧！罗四小姐要做新娘子了，我买这堂木器陪嫁，她大概不愿意我花钱，所以自己来看定了。这样子，明天我陪她来，你不要收她的银子，要收我的。”
en: “Of course. Why not?” “Do you want this furniture for yourself or as a gift?” “A gift.” “For whom?” “Never mind.” “If you tell me, perhaps something can be arranged.” “Very well. For the Miss Luo who came here with me last time.” Now Mr Li understood. This was the person Luo intended to bring. Smiling, he said, “What a coincidence indeed! The customer who has just bought it was Miss Luo herself.” The Seventh Lady was astonished. So Luo had been here? “She bought this set?” she asked quickly. “For how much?” “Eight hundred taels.” She nodded. “A fair enough price. How much deposit did she leave?” “None.” “None?” Her temper rose again. “Then why wouldn't you sell it to me?” “In business, a promise must count. Miss Luo came through you, Mrs Gu. Naturally, I trust her.” The Seventh Lady liked the sound of that and told him the truth. “Mr Li, Miss Luo is going to be a bride. I am buying the furniture for her dowry. She probably didn't want me to spend the money, so she came to choose it herself. Tomorrow I shall bring her here. Don't accept her money. Take mine.”

zh: “是，是！”“还有，你答应她八百两，当然还是八百两，不过我要杀你的价。杀价是假的，今天我先付你二百两，明天我杀价杀到六百两，你就说老主顾没办法，答应下来。这样做，为的是怕她替我心痛，你懂不懂？”“懂啊！怎么不懂？罗四小姐交到你这种朋友，真正前世福气，买木器陪嫁她，还要体谅她的心。这样子厚道细心的人，除了你古太太，寻不出第二个。”七姑奶奶买了这堂好木器，已觉踌躇满志，听了他这几句话，越发得意，高高兴兴付了定洋回家，将这桩称心如意的事，告诉了古应春。第二天，罗四姐来了，七姑奶奶一开口就说：“你昨天到昌发去过了？”罗四姐不知她何以得知？沉着地答说：“是的。”“你看中了一堂木器，价钱都讲好了？”“是的。讲定八百两银子。”“那再好都没有。”七姑奶奶说：“你真有眼光！我们走。”
en: “Certainly.” “One more thing. You promised her eight hundred taels, and eight hundred it must remain. But I shall bargain with you. It will only be pretence. I shall pay you two hundred today. Tomorrow, when I bargain you down to six hundred, say that you cannot refuse an old customer and agree. I don't want her to feel bad about my spending so much. Do you understand?” “Of course! Miss Luo must have earned the blessing of a friend like you in a previous life. You buy her dowry furniture and still take care to spare her feelings. No one could be more generous and considerate, Mrs Gu.” The Seventh Lady was already pleased with herself for securing such fine furniture. His praise made her happier still. She paid the deposit and went home in high spirits, telling Gu Yingchun how satisfactorily everything had worked out. When Luo arrived the next day, her first words were, “You went to Changfa yesterday?” Luo had no idea how she had found out, but answered composedly, “Yes.” “You chose a set of furniture and settled the price?” “Yes. Eight hundred taels.” “Then nothing could be better. You have a very good eye. Let us go.”

zh: 于是一车到了昌发。李老板早已茶烟、水果、点心都预备好了。略坐一坐，去看木器。“罗四小姐说，价钱跟你讲好了，是不是？”“是的。”“那是罗四小姐买，现在是我买。”七姑奶奶说：“李老板，我们我年往来，你应该格外克己，我出你六百两银子。”“古太太，我已经亏本了。”“我晓得你亏本，无非多年往来的交情，硬杀你二百两。”“下回我一定讲交情。这一回，”李老板斩钉截铁他说：“我的价钱，讲出算数，决不能改。”如此绝情，七姑奶奶气得脸色发白，真想狗血喷头骂他一，但一则是喜事，不宜吵架，二则也是舍不得这堂好木器，只好忍气吞声，连连冷笑道说：“好，好！算你狠。”说完，取出八百两银子的银票，往桌上一摔。“古太太，你请不要生气，我实在有苦衷，改天我到府上来赔罪。”“哪个要你来赔罪。我告诉你，这回是一闷棍的生意。”说完掉头就走，李老板追上来要分辩，七姑奶奶不理他，与罗四姐坐上马车回家，一路气鼓鼓的，话都懒得说，罗四姐也觉得好生无趣。
en: They drove to Changfa together. Mr Li had tea, tobacco, fruit and refreshments ready. After sitting for a little while, they went to inspect the furniture. “Miss Luo says she has settled the price with you. Is that right?” “Yes.” “That was when Miss Luo was buying. Now I am the buyer. We have dealt with each other for years, Mr Li. You ought to make a special concession. I offer six hundred taels.” “Mrs Gu, I am already losing money.” “I know. I am forcing another two hundred off the price only because we have been dealing with each other for so long.” “Next time I shall certainly show consideration. This time, however, my quoted price must stand. It cannot be changed.” His refusal was absolute. The Seventh Lady turned pale with fury. She wanted to give him a thorough tongue-lashing, but this was a wedding purchase, no occasion for a quarrel; besides, she could not bear to lose such fine furniture. Swallowing her anger, she laughed bitterly. “Very well. You win.” She took out banknotes for eight hundred taels and flung them onto the table. “Please don't be angry, Mrs Gu. I have a real difficulty. I shall come to your house another day to explain and apologize.” “Who wants your apology? Let me tell you, this is the last chance you will have to fleece me.” She turned and left. Mr Li hurried after her to explain, but she ignored him. She and Luo drove home, the Seventh Lady so angry that she scarcely spoke. Luo found the whole affair deeply unpleasant too.

zh: 一到家，在起坐问中遇见古应春。他一看爱妻神色不怡，便含笑问道：“高高兴兴出门，回来好象不大开心，为啥？”“昌发的李老板不上路！”七姑奶奶的声音很大，“以后再也不要作成他生意了。你说要带洋人到他那里定家具，省省！挑别家。”“怎么不上路？”“ 他，”七姑奶奶想一想说：“硬要我八百两银子。”“你照付了没有呢？”“你倒想！”七姑奶奶预先付过“差价”，是告诉过古应春的，他心里在想，李老板的生意做得很大，而且人虽精明，却很讲信用，似乎不至于硬吞二百两银子，其中或者另有缘故，只是当着罗四姐，不便深谈，只好沉默。
en: At home they found Gu in the sitting room. Seeing his wife's unhappy expression, he smiled and asked, “You went out so cheerfully. Why do you look so displeased now?” “Mr Li of Changfa doesn't know how to behave!” she declared loudly. “Never give him any more business. You said you would take a foreigner there to order furniture. Don't bother. Choose another shop.” “What did he do?” “He…” She paused. “He insisted on eight hundred taels.” “Did you pay?” “What do you think?” She had told Gu about paying the difference in advance. He knew that Mr Li had a large business and, though shrewd, was reliable. It seemed unlikely that he would simply pocket an extra two hundred taels. Perhaps there was another explanation. With Luo present, however, Gu could not pursue the matter and remained silent.

zh: 于是罗四姐便劝七姑奶奶说：“七姐，东西实在是好的，八百两银子是真正不贵。你先消消气，我要好好跟你商量，这堂木器有个用法。”七姑奶奶正要答话，让小大姐进来打断了。她是来通报，李老板来了，要见七姑奶奶。“不见。”“我见。”古应春接口，“等我来问他。”去了不多片刻，古应春笑嘻嘻地回进来，手里拿着个红封套，七姑奶奶接过来一看，封套签条上写“贺仪”二字，下面是李老板具名，贺仪是一张二百四十两的银票。“这算啥？”“不是送你的。”古应春说：“你不是告诉我，罗四姐要做新娘子了，人家是送喜事的贺礼。“听这一说，七姑奶奶与罗四姐相顾愕然，事出突兀，都用眼色催古应春说下去，但古应春却是一副忍俊不禁的神气。“你笑啥？”七姑奶奶白了丈夫一眼，“快说啊！”“怎么不要好笑？这种事也只有你们心思用得深的人，才做得出来。”
en: Luo tried to soothe her friend. “The furniture really is good, Seventh Sister. Eight hundred taels is very reasonable. Calm down first. I want to discuss a use I have in mind for it.” Before the Seventh Lady could reply, the maid came in to announce that Mr Li had arrived and wished to see her. “I won't see him.” “I will,” Gu said. “Let me question him.” He returned shortly afterwards, smiling broadly and carrying a red envelope. The Seventh Lady took it. On the label were the words “Wedding Gift,” with Mr Li's name below. Inside was a banknote for two hundred and forty taels. “What is this supposed to mean?” “It is not for you,” Gu said. “You told me Miss Luo was to be a bride, didn't you? This is his wedding present.” Taken completely by surprise, the two women exchanged bewildered looks, then urged him with their eyes to go on. But Gu seemed barely able to contain his laughter. His wife gave him a sharp look. “What are you laughing at? Tell us!” “How could I not laugh? Only people who think as deeply as you two could manage something like this.”

zh: 古应春看了罗四姐一眼，向妻子说道：“你晓得这堂木器多少钱？一千二百两。”“晴！”罗四姐叫了起来，“七姐夫，李老板告诉你了？”“当然告诉我了，不然，他另外收了二百两银子的定洋，硬不认帐，这话怎么交代呢？”“啊？”罗四姐问说：“七姐，你已付过他二百两？”七姑奶奶愣了一下，弄明白是怎么回事了，反问一句：“你先付过他四百两？”“是的。”“为啥？”“我不愿意你太破费。”“两个人走到一条路上来了。”七姑奶奶哈哈大笑，“我晓得你不愿意我太破费，所以预先付了他二百两。我道呢，哪里有这么便宜的东西！”罗四姐也觉得好笑，“七姐夫说得不错，心思用得太深，才会做出这种事来。你瞒我，我瞒你，大家都钻到牛角尖里去了。不过，”她说：“李老板也不大对，当时他就让二百两好了，何苦害七姐白白生一场气。”“他也有他的说法。”古应春接口答道：“我拿李老板的话照佯说一遍。他说：那位罗四小姐，看起来是很厉害的角色，我不能不防她，收条上写明白，报价只能报八百两，改口的话，加倍退还定洋，万一我改了口，罗四小姐拿出收条，一记‘翻天印，打过来，我没话说，所以我当时不松口，宁可得罪了古太太，事后来赔罪。“
en: Gu glanced at Luo, then told his wife, “Do you know what the furniture costs? Twelve hundred taels.” “Oh!” Luo exclaimed. “Brother-in-Law Gu, he told you?” “Of course. How else could he explain taking a further two hundred as deposit and then flatly refusing to acknowledge it?” “You had already paid him two hundred, Seventh Sister?” The Seventh Lady stared for a moment, then understood. “And you had paid four hundred first?” “Yes.” “Why?” “I didn't want you to spend too much.” The Seventh Lady burst out laughing. “We both took the same road! I knew you didn't want me to spend too much, so I paid him two hundred beforehand. I was wondering how such fine things could be so cheap.” Luo found it amusing too. “Brother-in-Law Gu is right. Only people who think too hard would do this. I kept it from you; you kept it from me; we both reasoned ourselves into a corner. Still, Mr Li was not quite right either. Why didn't he simply take two hundred less at the time, instead of making you angry for nothing?” “He has an explanation,” Gu replied. “Let me repeat his words. He said, ‘That Miss Luo looks a very formidable woman. I had to be on my guard. The receipt expressly says I must quote eight hundred taels, and if I change my words I must return double the deposit. Suppose I altered the price, and she produced the receipt and struck me with it like the Heaven-Overturning Seal? I would have no defence. That is why I would not give way. I preferred to offend Mrs Gu and come afterwards to apologize.’”

zh: 七姑奶奶前嫌尽释，高兴地笑道：“这个人还算上路，还多送了四十两贺礼。”说着将红封套递给罗四姐。“我不要。”罗四姐不肯接，“不是我的。”“莫非是我的？”七姑奶奶开玩笑：“又不是我做新娘子。”罗四姐窘笑着，仍旧不肯接，七姑奶奶的手也缩不回去，古应春说：“交给我。二百两是退回来的定洋，四十两送的贺礼，我叫人记笔帐在那里。”于是七姑奶奶将红封套交了给古应春，接着便盛赞那堂酸枝嵌螺甸的家具，认为一千二百两银子，实在也不算贵。
en: The Seventh Lady's resentment vanished. “He does know how to behave, after all,” she said happily. “He has even added forty taels as a wedding gift.” She handed the red envelope to Luo. “I don't want it. It isn't mine.” Luo refused to take it. “Then is it mine? I am not the one becoming a bride!” the Seventh Lady joked. Luo smiled in embarrassment but still refused, leaving her friend's hand suspended between them. “Give it to me,” Gu said. “Two hundred is the returned deposit, and forty is the wedding gift. I shall have them entered in the accounts.” His wife handed him the envelope, then began praising the suanzhi furniture with its mother-of-pearl inlay. Even twelve hundred taels, she thought, was not too much for it.

zh: 由此便谈到这堂木器的来历，它之贵重，已经不能拿银子多寡来论了。罗四姐因此有个想法，觉得自己用这堂木器，虽说出于“陪嫁”，亦嫌过分，难免遭人议论；因而私下跟七姑奶奶商量，打算把这堂木器，孝敬胡老太太。“我这个念头，是听了李老板的一句话才转到的，他说：有个江西的未道台，想买这堂木器孝敬一位总督的老太太。我心里就在想，将来我用这堂木器，胡老太太用的不及我，我用了心里也不安。倒不如借花献佛，做个人情。七姐，你不会怪我吧？”“哪里，哪里：”七姑奶奶异常欣慰地，“说实话，你这样子会做人，我就放心了。胡家人多口杂，我真怕你自己觉得行得正、坐得正，性子太直了，会得罪人。”“得罪人是免不了的。只要有几个人不得罪就好了。譬如胡老太太，一定要伺候得好。”七姑奶奶暗暗点头，心里在想，罗四姐一定懂。挟天子以令诸侯‘的道理，不但会做人，还会做“官”，替她担心，实在是多余的。
en: They went on to discuss the furniture's history. Its value could no longer be measured simply in silver. Luo had therefore formed a plan. Even if it were part of her dowry, such a set seemed too grand for her own use and might attract criticism. She privately proposed to the Seventh Lady that she present it to Old Madam Hu. “It was something Mr Li said that gave me the idea. A Circuit Intendant Zhu from Jiangxi had wanted to buy it for a governor-general's mother. I thought: if I use it and Old Madam Hu's furniture is not as fine, I shall feel uncomfortable. Better to offer borrowed flowers to the Buddha and turn it into a gift. You won't blame me, will you, Seventh Sister?” “Of course not.” The Seventh Lady was deeply pleased. “To tell the truth, seeing how well you understand people sets my mind at rest. There are so many people and so much gossip in the Hu household. I was afraid you might feel that, since you had done nothing wrong, you could be too outspoken and offend them.” “One cannot avoid offending people. As long as certain people are not offended, that is enough. Old Madam Hu, for instance, must be very well attended to.” The Seventh Lady nodded inwardly. Luo must understand the principle of holding the emperor in one's power to command the feudal lords, she thought. Luo knew not only how to deal with people but how to practise the art of government. Worrying about her had been quite unnecessary.
